newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka tenders to buy diesel, jet for Apr 11-12.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tenders to buy diesel, jet for Apr 11-12.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy 180,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel and 80,000 barrels of jet fuel for April 11-12 delivery, a CPC source said on Wednesday.
The cargo is for delivery to Colombo, on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
The tender closes on March 18 and offers will be valid for two days.

In its last tender, Sri Lanka bought 220,000 barrels of diesel at 65 cents per barrel above Singapore spot quotes, and 40,000 barrels of jet fuel at 75 cents above Singapore spot quotes, on a c-and-f basis to Colombo.
The combination cargo was purchased from Swiss trader Glencore.
